en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a ceremonial gathering of Eastern Orthodox clergy. A central patriarch in ornate vestments and a large crown stands surrounded by bishops and priests in richly decorated robes and tall black hats. In front of them are several large, elaborately decorated metal vessels, likely liturgical urns or ewers, flanked by palm or laurel branches. The setting appears to be in front of a church entrance. Printed caption text runs along the bottom in French, and there is cursive handwriting over the lower margin.
